description:
Igor Tulchinsky’s immigrant journey began when he was forced to depart Belarus along with his family, and all they were allowed to take with them was a single Ruble. Today, Tulchinsky’s quantitative investment firm manages billions of dollars in investments.

Tulchinsky sat down with Senior Editor Alex Knapp to discuss his story and how he is integrating AI into his company, World Quant.

author: Forbes
description:
As layoffs go, this one was remarkably well timed. In August 2019, Jeff Perera lost his job as a regional vice president for Atria Senior Living in central Florida. Just before that, his wife Danielle, who was home caring for their four-year-old daughter and one-year-old son, was offered a job by her old employer, Ross Stores, overseeing 16 Florida stores. She took the position and he became a stay-at-home dad.

New homebody Jeff started looking for hobbies. Danielle suggested a selfish one: Learn to make me bagels. Not just any bagels, but the fresh, chewy bagels she had loved growing up in Long Island, New York, and couldn’t find in the Orlando suburb of Windermere where they live. The kind where the dough is boiled before being baked. Jeff began experimenting. “YouTube and recipe books helped a ton, and lots and lots of trial and error. And a lot of them were bad. The early ones were bad,” he says.
